LanguageData.WotF_Form_Self.label: self
LanguageData.WotF_Form_Self.description: Cast on the caster and the caster's own cell. Nothing else is targeted.
LanguageData.WotF_Form_Touch.label: touch
LanguageData.WotF_Form_Touch.description: Cast on one adjacent, reachable target. A wall blocks it and it never reaches further than the neighbouring cells.
LanguageData.WotF_Form_Projectile.label: projectile
LanguageData.WotF_Form_Projectile.description: Flies as the existing homing arcane dart and resolves where it really hits. Only this form accepts pierce, accelerate, decelerate and split.
LanguageData.WotF_Form_Orbit.label: orbit
LanguageData.WotF_Form_Orbit.description: Places orbs that circle the caster and apply the arranged effects to the first pawn they touch. No target selection.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Harm.label: harm
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Harm.description: Arcane force damage to what the spell reaches.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Explosion.label: explosion
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Explosion.description: One native explosion at the spell's point. Area widens that single blast; Sensitive keeps it from damaging buildings.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Lightning.label: lightning
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Lightning.description: EMP and burn damage, plus a charge stack; later strikes hurt more for each stack already carried. The main answer to mechanoids.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_ColdSnap.label: cold snap
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_ColdSnap.description: Bursts against a target that is already slowed, adding a vulnerability multiplier to the base damage.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Freeze.label: freeze
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Freeze.description: Lowers the target's movement for a while. Nothing else about the target changes.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Knockback.label: knockback
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Knockback.description: Throws the target away from the impact point through the vanilla flying carrier. The value is the distance; Area decides who is thrown.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Pull.label: pull
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Pull.description: Drags the target towards the impact point through the vanilla flying carrier. The value is the distance.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Snare.label: snare
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Snare.description: Sets movement to zero while leaving attacks untouched. This is not a stun.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Hex.label: hex
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Hex.description: Marks the target to take more damage and heal more slowly for a while.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Heal.label: clot
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Heal.description: No direct healing: bandages every wound with no medicine and speeds natural healing for a while.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Grow.label: grow
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Grow.description: No instant maturity: the hit cell (a circle of cells with Area) grows plants faster for a while.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Magelight.label: magelight
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Magelight.description: Places a temporary light at the spell's point. Radius, colour and lifetime are frozen from the rune and its augments.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Blink.label: blink
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Blink.description: From a self cast the caster flickers forward; delivered by a dart or touch, the caster lands at the spell's point.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Linger.label: linger
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Linger.description: Leaves a force field at the point. Every interval it applies everything to its right to every pawn inside. Accelerate shortens the interval, Decelerate lengthens it.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Rune.label: rune
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Rune.description: Leaves a seal that takes no building space. The first pawn stepping on it gets everything to its right, then the seal is gone.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Delay.label: delay
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Delay.description: Everything to its right resolves a few seconds later at the same target point.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Amplify.label: amplify
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Amplify.description: Strengthens the effect on its left: damage, healing rate, light, throw distance and blast radius all scale with it.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Dampen.label: dampen
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Dampen.description: Weakens the effect on its left: less damage, shorter throw, dimmer light.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_AOE.label: area
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_AOE.description: Widens the effect on its left over nearby targets. Each target is affected once, and an explosion still detonates once.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Extend.label: extend time
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Shorten.label: shorten time
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Shorten.description: Makes the effect last a shorter time.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Sensitive.label: sensitive
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Sensitive.description: Keeps only the controlled half: an explosion no longer damages buildings.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_BreakArmor.label: break armor
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_BreakArmor.description: Adds armour penetration to the damage effect on its left.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Pierce.label: pierce
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Pierce.description: Lets the projectile on its left keep flying after a hit. Each extra hit spends one pierce. Cannot be combined with split.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Accelerate.label: accelerate
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Accelerate.description: Faster projectile, faster orbit, or a shorter Linger interval.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Decelerate.label: decelerate
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Decelerate.description: Slower projectile, slower orbit, or a longer Linger interval.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Split.label: split
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Split.description: Adds more darts to the projectile on its left, or one more orb to an orbit. On a projectile it cannot be combined with pierce.
